data.human_instructions:
v1.93.0 — the release runner drives the release. ONE member (05de711d, closed).

THE ORDER, and this run exists to prove a machine walks it:
  LOCK -> BOOTSTRAP -> STEPS -> BUILD -> STAGE -> PREFLIGHT -> ORCHESTRATOR -> FIRE

It was first written down on 2026-08-23 by argus-a155, inside an abandoned run's
own instructions, with the note "recorded because it existed nowhere". v1.92 skipped
the ORCHESTRATOR step, so orchestrator_started_at stayed null, so the scorecard was
invalid, so completion was never observed: the release went public with its journal
open. Two mechanisms now refuse that silently happening again — the runner will not
reach the publish step without the orchestrator moment in this journal, and the
fire's own preflight carries an eleventh gate that refuses for the same reason.

DRIVE IT WITH:
  python3 vault/tools/tropo-release-run.py --release-plan-uid 2e15ef76 --execute
Re-run after every halt. Steps already recorded terminal are skipped.

MIKE OWES FOUR GESTURES (counted against profile 6bf18510, corrected at review —
the draft said two):
  1. the plan lock                        [DONE 2026-08-27, gesture 1 of 4]
  2. the orchestrator run                 (a PRINCIPAL INPUT: stamped actor mike and
                                           counted on the scorecard; the runner
                                           refuses to write it, because a machine
                                           writing it would forge a human gesture
                                           inside the number built to measure human
                                           cost)
  3. step bc6b17ec, the external test pass against the candidate
  4. the fire

THE DELIVERABLE IS A NUMBER. Every mechanical command that lands on Mike's keyboard
between those four gestures is counted and published beside the version, whatever it
says. v1.92 cost ~20 manual CLI invocations, 4 live machinery repairs and 6
hand-authored events on top of 5 genuine judgments. The target is judgments
unchanged, mechanical friction eliminated. If it is not cheaper, that is the finding,
with numbers, never an assurance.
